violation_type.title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location Inside (26 TAC §747.5007(4))
violation_type.short_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location Inside
violation_type.typical_finding: The diagram did not have a designated location inside where adults and children can take shelter.

finding_variants.text: The diagram did not have a designated location inside where adults and children can take shelter.
The operation did not have a diagram indicating a relocation area inside the home.
The evacuation and relocation diagram did not show the designated location inside the home where all adults and children take shelter from threatening weather.

The designated location inside the child-care home was not available in emergency diagram.    Note : corrected.    The caregiver chose the designated location inside the her child care home and fixed the diagram.
The designated location inside the home  was not available in her emergency evacuation and relocation diagram.
The evacuation plan was lacking documentation for the designated location inside where children and caregivers go in the event of severe weather  or lock down.
